title.zh: 将巴塔内斯省伊瓦纳市镇的圣维森特小村改设为该市镇的圣维森特村的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of San Vicente in the Municipality of Ivana, Province of Batanes, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Vicente of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of San Vicente in the Municipality of Ivana, Province of Batanes, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Vicente of Said Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio San Vicente tại Thị trấn Ivana, Tỉnh Batanes thành Barrio với tên gọi Barrio San Vicente của thị trấn nói trên
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ San Vicente ในเทศบาล Ivana จังหวัด Batanes เป็น บาริโอในชื่อบาริโอ San Vicente ของเทศบาลดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio San Vicente di Kotamadya Ivana, Provinsi Batanes menjadi Barrio dengan nama Barrio San Vicente dari kotamadya tersebut
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio San Vicente di Perbandaran Ivana, Wilayah Batanes kepada Barrio dengan nama Barrio San Vicente daripada perbandaran tersebut

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1331_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of San Vicente in the Municipality of Ivana, Province of Batanes, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio San Vicente of said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
